en: The image depicts a vintage postcard featuring an embroidered or woven textile scene. The scene shows several figures in 18th-century European aristocratic dress, likely participating in an indoor fencing or theatrical performance. The figures include both men and women, posed dramatically in an ornate room with patterned wallpaper and draped curtains. The border of the postcard is decorated with a subtle embossed design. There is handwritten French text at the top and bottom of the postcard.
